product_family: AI music generation platform offering generative music creation tools with commercial licensing. Main products: consumer-facing boomy.com platform and B2B API suite (algorithmic, loop & one-shot, text-to-music generation). No public enterprise offering with managed compliance.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 2
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of SOC 2 Type 2 certification found on vendor domain. Nudge Security profile lists this certification, but notes 'Links to security documentation... were present but inactive on the source page.'

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 27001 certification found on vendor domain. Not mentioned in boomy.com, boomycorporation.com, or support documentation.

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of GDPR compliance program or certification on vendor domain.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of HIPAA compliance or certification. Not applicable to Boomy's use case (music generation, not healthcare data handling).

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of PCI DSS certification on vendor domain, despite payment processing (Stripe integration noted in Nudge Security profile).

privacy.ai_training_note: Boomy states all generative music models are copyright-safe and not trained on copyrighted data. Models built using proprietary generative composition techniques created by Boomy team musicians. No evidence of customer data being used for model training.

security.name: Authentication methods
security.value: Supports Google login, Microsoft login, and SSO capability. Two-factor authentication not currently supported via SMS, email, hardware, software, TOTP, or U2F.

security.name: Fraud detection
security.value: Partnered with Beatdapp (blockchain-powered streaming content auditor) to detect and prevent streaming fraud on music distribution.

products.name: Boomy Consumer Platform
products.data_scope: User-generated music content, account data, payment information
products.notes: Consumer-facing web platform at boomy.com. Free and paid memberships (Creator, Pro). Full commercial rights granted to users for downloads. 22M+ songs created to date.

products.name: Boomy API Suite
products.data_scope: API calls, generated music, optional customer training data
products.notes: B2B API offerings: algorithmic generation, loop/one-shot samples, text-to-music. Custom model training available with client-supplied data. Available via boomycorporation.com.

flags: A third-party security aggregator (Nudge Security) lists SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI DSS, FedRAMP, and CSA STAR Level 1 certifications for Boomy, but none are confirmed on Boomy's own domain (boomy.com or boomycorporation.com); the aggregator's page notes its links to security documentation were present but inactive.
No dedicated security, compliance, or trust documentation is available on Boomy's website.

Boomy Corporation is located in Berkeley, CA (2991 Sacramento St. Unit #207, Berkeley, CA 94702); contact email help@boomy.com. Not to be confused with Boomi (boomi.com), an unrelated enterprise integration platform.

Boomy faced compliance issues in 2023-2024 involving streaming fraud: Spotify pulled tens of thousands of tracks citing concerns that Boomy-generated music was used to manipulate streaming payouts. Boomy responded with a partnership with Beatdapp.
Two-factor authentication is not supported (no SMS, email, hardware, software, TOTP, or U2F options).
Boomy was founded in 2019 and is backed by major music industry investors; its size and compliance maturity are consistent with a growth-stage startup rather than an enterprise vendor.
